description: Defines the CKEDITOR.dom.text class, representing a DOM text node with methods for manipulation such as split, getText, getLength, and substring.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.text
classes.description: A class representing a DOM text node with methods for text manipulation and splitting.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the text node at the specified offset into two sibling nodes.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the text content.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the node.

methods.name: substring
methods.description: Extracts a substring from the text content between specified indices.
